name: Jiangsu Asia-Pacific Light Alloy Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Asia-Pacific Light Alloy Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of aluminum products in China and internationally. The company offers precision aluminum tubes, special profiles and high-precision bars, other automotive and industrial aluminum extrusions, and new energy vehicle components. Its produsts are used in aerospace, military, civilian integration, fusion, air conditioning, and marine engineering. The company was formerly known as Jiangsu Yatal Aluminium Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Jiangsu Asia-Pacific Light Alloy Technology Co., Ltd. in September 2007.
